SHOPTRADE.CurrencyModeHint: Coins: all dnd5e coins with change making. Single: one coin type only. A world whose config has one currency (like Berries) is always single.
SHOPTRADE.SellRatio: Shop sell ratio (percent of the price a shop pays)
SHOPTRADE.TemplateSetHint: Which shop types the Start a shop prompt offers. One Piece: the original types stocked from the Shop Catalogues journal in Berries. Fantasy: blacksmith, general store, inn, apothecary, alchemist, bookseller, stables, jeweler, arcane emporium and more, stocked from the compendium below and priced in gold.
SHOPTRADE.CompendiumHint: The Item compendium the Fantasy shop types draw their stock from, as a pack id such as world.drathmir-compendium.
